t: The Forever Machine: Architecting Digital Sovereignty in the Age of AI
s: This article outlines the 'Forever Machine,' a personal digital ecosystem built with tools like NixOS and local LLMs, to preserve individual agency and foster 'Black Swan' innovation against digital centralization, promoting 'Resistance through Competence' as a 'Kantian unit.'
sub: Root Anchoring & Nomadic Capability with NixOS
Local LLMs as 'Tamagotchi AI' for amplification
WET Code for AI-readable, future-proof workflows
Nurturing Black Swan innovation via the Forever Machine
